title: Macch plugin manifest
description: One remote MCP server that operators can connect to Macch's agent from the Marketplace.

$schema.description: Link to this schema, for editor validation.

slug.description: Unique plugin id. Lowercase words joined by hyphens; must equal the file name. The agent sees each tool as <slug>_<tool>.

name.description: Display name shown in the Marketplace.

summary.description: One short sentence per locale saying what operators can do with the plugin. en-US is required; es-AR and pt-BR are strongly recommended.

publisher.description: Who builds and runs the MCP server.

server_url.description: Public https URL of the Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.

connection.description: operator: each operator signs in with their own account. company: an admin connects one shared account.

auth.description: oauth: MCP authorization spec. api_key: sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. none: no credentials.

docs_url.description: Public https page that documents the MCP server.

listed.description: Whether the Marketplace shows the plugin. Macch sets false to hide it.

staff_only.description: Whether only Macch staff see the plugin in the Marketplace, for Macch's own test plugins. Macch sets it.

review.description: Review number. Macch raises it when it re-reviews a tool whose read_only flag did not change.

tools.description: The MCP tools the agent may use, by tool name. Tools missing here are never shown to the agent.

read_only.description: true: the agent runs the tool without asking the operator (Macch verifies it only reads). false: the operator approves each call.

suggestions.description: Up to three first questions the plugin brings to an empty chat with the agent, shown once an operator can use the plugin. Each is a short question or request an operator would type, with no sample customer data.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the manifest. Lowercase words joined by hyphens.

icon.description: Icon Macch Admin shows next to the question. The list matches the icons Macch Admin ships; Macch adds names here when it adds icons.

text.description: The question per locale, under about 30 characters. en-US is required; es-AR and pt-BR are strongly recommended.
